data_availability_text: DATA AVAILABILITY STATEMENTAll requests for raw and analyzed data and materials from the TRIAD cohort will be promptly reviewed by McGill University to verify if the request is subject to any intellectual property or confidentiality obligations. Anonymized data will be shared upon request to the study's senior author from a qualified academic investigator for the sole purpose of replicating the procedures and results presented in this article. Any data and materials that can be shared will be released via a material transfer agreement. Data are not publicly available due to information that could compromise the privacy of research participants. Related documents, including study protocol and informed consent forms, can similarly be made available upon request.
